FIELDS.NAME: Comfort Haven Furniture
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Comfort Haven Furniture operates as a retail furniture store located in Springfield, Illinois, specializing in the sale of quality home furnishings. Our primary operations include a well-designed showroom of under 10,000 square feet where customers can explore a curated selection of living room, dining room, and bedroom furniture, along with accessories to enhance their home decor. 

We emphasize customer satisfaction through a dedicated sales team that provides personalized service, ensuring customers receive tailored recommendations to fit their style and budget. The store operates under strict safety protocols, promoting an environment that prioritizes customer and employee well-being. Delivery and installation services are handled by our in-house team, all of whom have undergone comprehensive training to ensure safe and efficient setup of purchased products.

Inventory is securely stored in a monitored facility, ensuring protection against potential risks. Our operations focus solely on retail, providing a range of pre-assembled and flat-pack furniture to minimize installation hazards. We maintain a clear return and warranty policy to foster trust and satisfaction among our customer base. Overall, Comfort Haven Furniture is committed to providing a superior shopping experience in a safe and controlled environment.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Loss Description: On March 15, 2023, a delivery truck was involved in a minor accident during a furniture delivery, resulting in property damage to the customer's driveway and a claim settlement of $1,200. The claim has been closed as of April 5, 2023, with no ongoing issues.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 10:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sunday: Closed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Monitored security system with on-site watchpersons during business hours.

Our operations are focused solely on retailing pre-assembled and flat-pack furniture without any hazardous materials involved.
FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – Comfort Haven Furniture sponsors local athletic teams as part of their community engagement efforts. This involvement helps promote brand awareness and support for local initiatives.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance. The certificates are checked by our internal compliance team to ensure all contractors are properly insured.
FIELDS.G4: Has any applicant been indicted or c: No – Comfort Haven Furniture has not been indicted or convicted of any degree of the crime of fraud, bribery, arson, or any related crime in connection with this or any other property.
FIELDS.G5: Any policy or coverage declined, can: No – Comfort Haven Furniture has not had any policies or coverage declined, canceled, or non-renewed in the past three years. The business has maintained a clean insurance record.
FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – Comfort Haven Furniture does not lease employees to or from other employers. All staff are directly employed and trained in-house for delivery and installation services.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – Comfort Haven Furniture carries workers' compensation insurance to ensure compliance with legal requirements and to protect both employees and the business from potential liabilities.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – Comfort Haven Furniture does not own or operate any other businesses. Our focus is solely on retail furniture sales and related services.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – Comfort Haven Furniture does not have any other insurance policies with this company at this time. All current coverage is represented by the existing policy numbers listed.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – Comfort Haven Furniture is not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products. Our operations focus solely on retailing pre-assembled and flat-pack furniture.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – Comfort Haven Furniture does not rent or loan equipment to others; our operations focus solely on retailing furniture and related services.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – Comfort Haven Furniture has not had any foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien in the past five years, and maintains a clean financial record.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Comfort Haven Furniture does not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals as our operations focus solely on retailing pre-assembled and flat-pack furniture without any hazardous materials involved.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Comfort Haven Furniture does not have any catastrophe exposure as its operations are limited to retailing furniture without involvement in high-risk activities.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – Comfort Haven Furniture has not had any past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring. The company maintains a focus on compliance and ethical hiring practices.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – Comfort Haven Furniture currently has no uncorrected fire code violations and maintains compliance with all safety regulations.
